commentaire: Jeu de cas Racket pour la famille du pli sur arbre binaire. Memes ecritures que cas_ml.json quand elles existent en Racket, plus les variantes propres a Racket : distinction par predicats, filtrage racket/match, ordre libre des operandes d'une somme n-aire.

equivalentes.etiquette: cond et predicat du cas vide
equivalentes.code:
(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (cond [(leaf? t) 0]
        [else (+ (node-v t) (somme (node-l t)) (somme (node-r t)))]))

equivalentes.etiquette: cond et predicat du noeud d'abord
equivalentes.code:
(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (cond [(node? t) (+ (node-v t) (somme (node-l t)) (somme (node-r t)))]
        [else 0]))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (if (leaf? t) 0 (+ (node-v t) (somme (node-l t)) (somme (node-r t)))))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (match t
    [(leaf) 0]
    [(node v l r) (+ v (somme l) (somme r))]))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme arbre)
  (match arbre
    [(node valeur g d) (+ valeur (somme g) (somme d))]
    [(leaf) 0]))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (cond [(leaf? t) 0]
        [else (+ (somme (node-l t)) (somme (node-r t)) (node-v t))]))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define somme
  (lambda (t)
    (cond [(leaf? t) 0]
          [else (+ (node-v t) (somme (node-l t)) (somme (node-r t)))])))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (cond [(leaf? t) 0]
        [(node? t) (+ (node-v t) (somme (node-l t)) (somme (node-r t)))]))

distinctes.code:
(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t) (foldl + 0 (aplatir t)))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (let loop ([t t] [acc 0])
    (if (leaf? t) acc (loop (node-r t) (loop (node-l t) (+ acc (node-v t)))))))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (cond [(leaf? t) 1]
        [else (* (node-v t) (somme (node-l t)) (somme (node-r t)))]))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (cond [(leaf? t) 0]
        [else (+ 1 (max (somme (node-l t)) (somme (node-r t))))]))

distinctes.etiquette: comptage des noeuds, constante au lieu du champ
distinctes.code:
(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t)
  (cond [(leaf? t) 0]
        [else (+ 1 (somme (node-l t)) (somme (node-r t)))]))

(struct leaf () #:transparent)
(struct node (v l r) #:transparent)
(define (somme t) (for/sum ([x (aplatir t)]) x))
